moments.author: Adam Schefter
moments.quote: Three‑time Pro‑Bowl RB Jahmyr Gibbs and the Lions reached agreement on a 3‑year, $67.5 M deal (up to $75.75 M), $51.5 M guaranteed, making him the NFL’s highest‑paid RB.
